justification: Inspected core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/maxicode/decoder/Decoder.java, core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/maxicode/MaxiCodeReader.java, and core/src/test/java/com/google/zxing/maxicode/Maxicode1TestCase.java. The target has some fan-out (it directly depends on BitMatrixParser, DecodedBitStreamParser, ReedSolomonDecoder/GenericGF/ReedSolomonException, BitMatrix, DecoderResult, DecodeHintType, FormatException, ChecksumException, and Map), but fan-in is very low: source search found only one production caller, MaxiCodeReader, which holds a single Decoder field and invokes it; no other source or test files reference com.google.zxing.maxicode.decoder.Decoder. That is not enough evidence for hub-like modularization.
